name: CodeBlock
description: Syntax-highlighted code block with language label and copy-to-clipboard button.
designIntent: Display AI-generated or referenced code readably with one-click copy.

antiPatterns.title: Do not nest CodeBlock in Response code fences manually
antiPatterns.explanation: Response already routes fenced code to CodeBlock.

accessibility.implementation: Icon-labeled button with aria-label that flips to Copied.
